name: Default Koromali Golden Rules
description: The standard set of fundamental rules for AI code generation, emphasizing a clean, patch-like output.
rules: Your response MUST ONLY contain file modifications, creations, deletions, or renames.
Do not add any extra commentary, explanations, or summaries outside of the formatted blocks.
If a file from the user's prompt is not being changed, DO NOT include it in your response.
Ensure file paths are relative to the project root and use forward slashes (e.g., `app_core/main.py`).
You can use `~~~` as an alternative to ``` for code blocks; the system will automatically convert it. This is useful for markdown files.
